name: CrossPlanet
detailed_description:
CrossPlanet – A Free Multiplayer Shooter Born from Passion

CrossPlanet is a fast-paced third-person multiplayer shooter focused on fluid movement, skill-based combat, and satisfying gunplay. Developed over 4 years by 2 core developers and a handful of friends assisting, CrossPlanet is now being released for free, in its current state, as a love letter to the genre and the players who still crave tight, gameplay-first arena shooters.

Originally envisioned as a much larger experience, the project simply grew beyond the scope our tiny team could complete. But rather than let it disappear, we’ve chosen to share it freely with the world. No paywalls, no microtransactions, just gameplay.

Pure Shooter Gameplay. No Fluff.

CrossPlanet puts combat at the core. Sprint, double jump, evade, jetpack, aim down sights, and outmaneuver your enemies across a variety of dynamic multiplayer maps and modes. Choose from 11 distinct weapons, each with unique handling and purpose, 2 vehicles with insane power and durability, and engage in high-stakes battles that reward precision and movement.

Key Features:

✅ Multiplayer Warfare – Jump into competitive PVP action with no pay-to-win mechanics.
✅ Diverse Arsenal – Master 11 unique weapons with distinct recoil, roles, and tactics.
✅ Tactical Movement – Sprint, double jump, evade, jetpack and use the environment to gain the upper hand.
✅ Skill-Based Combat – Gameplay is king. Victory depends on your aim, your timing, and your strategy.
✅ Customization – Unlock 10 unique earnable armors to show off your achievements in battle. And a handful of skins for each.
✅ Plenty of Content – Fight across 10 PVP maps in 15 unique multiplayer modes.

The game features in-game stats, leaderboards, bots, and a flying camera for screenshots.

This is CrossPlanet — raw, honest, and driven by passion. While it's not a finished game, it's a piece of our journey we’re proud to share. We’ve learned so much through its development, and this release ensures that all the time, energy, and effort put into the game lives on through its players.

Thank you for playing.

🎮 Join our Discord to look for players and connect with the community!

Wield a variety of weapons and outmaneuver enemies to win. No fluff, no microtransactions, just pure action and passion shared with the world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 22 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-14400 or AMD Ryzen 5 9600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 6600 XT or Nvidia RTX 3060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 22 GB available space
